title: EVERYONE POOPS BUT NO ONE WANTS TO TALK ABOUT IT: THE LIVED EXPERIENCES OF YOUNG PEOPLE WITH INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE
text: EVERYONE POOPS BUT NO ONE WANTS TO TALK ABOUT IT: THE LIVED EXPERIENCES OF YOUNG PEOPLE WITH INFLAMMATORY BOWEL DISEASE. Thesis (Master, Kinesiology & Health Studies) -- Queen's University, 2011-08-09 10:39:24.603

title: Do tree planters live on the edge?: health risk-taking among reforestation workers in Northern British Columbia
text: Do tree planters live on the edge?: health risk-taking among reforestation workers in Northern British Columbia. This thesis examines the perceptions, attitudes, and behaviour of treeplanters in the context of the subculture in which they live and work.
